x-k-k6-01.title: Qabxii jalqabaa kamtu jaarsaan eeyyee jedha?
x-k-k6-01.goal: Qabxii jalqabaa kadhannaa afur jechootaan murteessi, bakka wanta kadhannaa salphaatti kenname fi qabxii jalqabaa kabajaa qabu garuu hin hojjanne ibsi.
x-k-k6-01.material:
Ati barataa waggaa jalqabaa yunivarsiitii dha. 민준 선배 kiilaba keessaa jaarsa waggaa sadii si caalaa guddaa dha; isa wajjin altaa lama qofa dubbatteetta. Torbaan darbe barnoota keessatti yaadannoo gaarii barreesse. Qormaanni kee boru waaree booda dha, har'a yaadannoo ilaaluu barbaadda. Ergaa afur qabxii jalqabaa barreessite:

Draft A: 선배, 지난주 필기 보내 줘요. 내일 시험이에요.
Draft B: 선배님, 혹시 지난주 필기를 사진으로 보내 주실 수 있을까요? 내일 시험이라서요.
Draft C: 선배님, 바쁘시겠지만 시간 되실 때 아무 때나 지난주 필기를 보여 주시면 정말 감사하겠습니다.
Draft D: 선배님, 필기 보내 주세요. 안 보내 주시면 저 시험 망해요.
x-k-k6-01.thinking.0: Qabxii jalqabaa ragaa jechootaa wajjin wal bira qabuu
x-k-k6-01.thinking.1: Sadarkaa kabajaa fi bu'a qabeessummaa addaan baasuu
x-k-k6-01.s.s1.prompt: Jechoota qofa irraa murteessuun, qabxiin jalqabaa kamtu yeroo itti eeyyee fedhii qabuu argachuuf carraa caalaa qaba?
x-k-k6-01.s.s1.hint.0: Qabxii jalqabaa hundi eenyuuf akka barreeffame fakkaatu wal bira qabi.
x-k-k6-01.s.s1.hint.1: Qabxii jalqabaa hundaaf gaafadhu: jaarsaaf diduuf karaa mijaa'aa kenna, inni yoom akka si barbaachisu ni baraa?
x-k-k6-01.s.s1.r.a: Bocni gaaffii kan diddaaf bakka kennu, sababa fi dhiibbaa yeroo wajjin, hubatteetta.
x-k-k6-01.s.s1.r.b: Kun hiriyoota dhiyoo gidduu haasaa yookaan ajaja fakkaata; dubbataan qormaata hubate garuu hariiroo hin hubanne.
x-k-k6-01.s.s1.r.c: Kabajaa olaanaa madaalte; ergaan baayyee kabajaa qabu illee dubbisaan yoom akka barbaachisu ni himaa mirkaneessi.
x-k-k6-01.s.s1.r.d: Xumurawwan kabajaa jiru, garuu hima lammaffaan itti gaafatamummaa jaarsa irra kaa'a. Qaqqabuu irratti akkamitti akka dhaga'amu ilaali.
x-k-k6-01.s.s1.explain: Draft B kan boqonnaa jiraachuu gaafata (혹시 + -(으)ㄹ 수 있을까요), sababa kenna, sababni immoo dhiibbaa yeroo agarsiisa. Draft C baayyee kabajaa qaba garuu boru barbaachisa tasuma hin jedhu, kanaaf jaarsi torban dhufu deebisuu danda'a. Draft A jaarsa fagoo ta'eef michummaa kabajaa hin qabu, Draft D immoo isa dhiibba.
x-k-k6-01.s.s1.acc.0: B qofa gaaffii laaffate, sababa, fi yeroo daangaa mul'atu walitti makaa.
x-k-k6-01.s.s2.prompt: Himoota 2-3 keessatti (Afaan Ingiliffaa yookaan Afaan Koreaa) ibsi: (1) jechoonni kamtu Draft B kadhannaa godhu bakka ajajaa, fi (2) maaliif Draft C, baayyee kabajaa qabaatus, yaadannoo yeroo itti kennu si hin argamsiisu.
x-k-k6-01.s.s2.hint.0: Jechoota Afaan Koreaa sirrii Draft B irraa yaadde dhahi.
x-k-k6-01.s.s2.hint.1: Kutaa 2 f, akka jaarsaa yaadi Draft C dubbisi: maal hin beektu?
x-k-k6-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Jechoota Afaan Koreaa qabxii jalqabaa irraa dhaheettaa, 'kabajaa qaba' jechuu qofa osoo hin ta'in?
x-k-k6-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Rakkoo C dhaabbata jaarsaa irraa ibsiteettaa?
x-k-k6-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Hiriyaan biraa qabxiiwwan koo lamaan addaan baasuu danda'aa?
x-k-k6-01.s.s2.model.0: Xumurri -(으)ㄹ 수 있을까요 fi 혹시 kadhannaa gaaffii danda'uu gara ta'u godha, kanaaf jaarsi salphaatti diduu danda'a, 시험이라서요 immoo sababa kenna. Draft C boru tasuma hin jedhu, kanaaf jaarsi dafaa ta'uu hin beeku torban dhufu deebisuu danda'a.
x-k-k6-01.s.s2.model.1: B keessatti gaaffiin '보내 주실 수 있을까요?' ajajuu bakka hayyama gaafata. C kabajaa qaba, garuu 'yeroo qabdu' jechuun dafaa miti jedhee jaarsa beeksisa, kunis haala kee faallaa dha: daangaan boru dha.
x-k-k6-01.s.s2.modelNote.1: Akkamitti dubbisaan akka dubbisu irratti xiyyeeffata.

x-k-k6-03.title: Osoo hin jedhin dura
x-k-k6-03.goal: Gaaffilee afeerraa fudhachuu dura barbaachisan murteessi, daangaa kee mataa kee wajjin, achiis deebii kabajaan isaan gaafatu barreessi.

Hiriyaan kee 하준, kan altaa muraasa dubbatte, ergaa kana si ergee:

하준: 토요일에 집들이 해요! 우리 집은 학교 앞 서점 옆이에요. 시간 되면 와요~
